findings.problem: A legacy computer request without draftStateRevision bypassed the active-run check and could publish after cancellation.
findings.fix: Check the active run under the existing locks before the optional revision comparison. Active legacy clients still deliver useful replies.
findings.coverage: In-flight text/widget cancellation in both variants; two actual-model interruption trials with the field removed from the wire request.

findings.problem: Fresh automatic-send failures fell through to editable-card text; unknown delivery wording could imply a completed send.
findings.fix: Keep authoritative failure/uncertainty notes and explicitly distinguish not-delivered from unconfirmed. Unknown receipts do not confirm a send and forbid resending.
findings.coverage: Database+formatter regressions, two clear live failed cases, four final clear live unknown cases. One earlier ambiguous live phrasing is retained as a finding.

findings.problem: A stopped-turn delivery receipt instructed the model to tell the user it did not go through, despite the turn being inactive.
findings.fix: Return the explicit ended-turn/do-not-retry note instead of the generic channel failure template.

findings.problem: In-flight cards said Ready to send; failed/unconfirmed automatic-send cards said Sent without review.
findings.fix: Desktop and iOS use Sending while in flight and Review skipped unless delivery is confirmed sent.
findings.coverage: Native Chrome actions on the real desktop review component with isolated services and a gated synthetic sender; failed/unconfirmed history reopens read-only. Swift syntax check passes; full iOS build is blocked separately.
